title: world fixture — terrain layout + placed entities for a run (W9; world-gen OR scenario)
description: The UNIFIED per-run fixture (docs/world-integration.md W9): the same shape whether produced by the world-gen generator (backend/tools/worldgen, author-time, seeded — docs/world-gen.md WG1-a) OR hand-authored as a scenario. The engine does NOT generate at runtime (D12): backend/tools/worldgen.Load parses this, builds the env states (navmap/climate/flora/decay + the animal set + scent grid) and calls world.InstallEnv/InstallFauna + Spawn/PlaceObject. This is a PER-RUN artifact, NOT content (architecture §7) — but it is schema-validated by the loader like content. EVERYTHING except schema_version+seed is OPTIONAL: an absent block ⇒ that subsystem is OFF (env-neutral). Terrain ids ⊆ content/terrain.yaml; species ⊆ content/objects.yaml flora:/fauna: (loader cross-checks, D10).

seed.description: the run seed (D12) — the world-gen RNG seed AND the sim root seed source; same seed ⇒ same world.

bounds.description: The finite rectangle the env grids span (W1). Overrides content/world.yaml's default bounds. Absent ⇒ use the world.yaml default.

terrain.description: The per-cell terrain LAYOUT at navmap resolution over bounds (the navmap base layer + climate t=0 terrain). Absent ⇒ no navmap/env terrain (flat default; env terrain-driven features off). TWO mutually exclusive forms: EXPLICIT {cols,rows,cells} (`cells` row-major, length cols*rows, ids ⊆ content/terrain.yaml) OR RANDOM {random:true} — the loader materializes a SimpleTerrain layout over navmap.OffsetDimsOf(bounds) from the run seed (dev/test worlds; same seed ⇒ same terrain, D12).

cols.description: grid columns = round((max.x-min.x)/navmap_cell_size); loader cross-checks vs world.yaml.

cells.description: row-major terrain ids (length MUST equal cols*rows; loader enforces). Each ∈ content/terrain.yaml.

random.description: loader-materialized SimpleTerrain over the run seed (dev/test; NOT the WG1-a Generate pipeline).

objects.description: Placed in-world objects (ore_node, water_source, shelter, station:*, …). `kind` ∈ content/objects.yaml object_kinds. `remaining` only for a finite `source` node (ore_node, Xm1). `owner` only for owned objects.

agents.description: Agent placements. RealStats are SAMPLED by world.Spawn from the stat GenSpec with the seeded RNG (NOT in the fixture) — the fixture carries placement + optional Value/threat seeding (live-emergence lever, world-gen WG5/§6). Absent ⇒ no agents.

animals.description: Fauna placements (F18 suitability seeding). Absent/empty ⇒ fauna OFF (no InstallFauna animals → fauna-neutral). `species` ∈ content/objects.yaml fauna: blocks.

animal_templates.description: Per-species initial fauna runtime vectors. Each placed animal reads its species template so §6 combat/graze/speed formulas have real Stat and drive inputs at t=0.

flora.description: Flora placements (suitability seeding). Absent/empty ⇒ flora OFF. `species` ∈ content/objects.yaml flora: blocks. length/width default to seedling start (world.yaml sizes) when omitted.

lots.description: Optional initial perishable decay lots (usually empty — most lots arise at runtime from harvest/craft). `kind` ∈ content/objects.yaml decay: item_kinds.

respawn_targets.description: Per-run OVERRIDE of the content per-species respawn_target (F9 carrying capacity, content/objects.yaml fauna:). Keys = fauna species ids (loader cross-checks); values replace the content value for THIS run only. Absent ⇒ content values.

remaining.description: finite-source count for an ore_node (Xm1); omit for non-source objects (defaults to source.initial).

values.description: optional initial Value/dimension seeding (live-emergence lever); keys = need/value Dimension ids.

pos.description: optional; absent ⇒ the loader places the animal on a random soil hex from the run seed (requires a terrain layout).
optional; absent ⇒ the loader places the plant on a random soil hex from the run seed (requires a terrain layout).

length.description: optional initial height; default = world.yaml sizes.flora.seedling_start.

width.description: optional initial canopy; default = seedling start.

location.description: optional storage/inventory handle; default = floor at pos (objectPlacement carries pos).
